delivery.codex_round_1: Implement comments, admin, contact, analytics, local integration tests and one configuration checklist; no remote deploy
delivery.owner_setup: One account/settings session; confirm all missing values and test-deployment permissions together
delivery.codex_round_2: Connect verified settings and perform real staging tests in the same PR; do not rebuild or redesign
after_services: M6 separately authorized merge/release sequence and launch

do_not_change: original article bodies and baseline hashes
existing popularity values and metric definitions

cost_policy.on_limit_exceeded: degrade only the affected service; preserve readable site and unsent input; never silently charge
cost_policy.existing_paid_account: requires explicit cost review before using it; do not alter other projects or promise zero charges

comments.admin_identity: Cloudflare Access Free with One-time PIN and exact author email allowlist
comments.delete_credential: per-comment client-generated CSPRNG >=256bit; server stores digest only; preserve on retry; never in URLs or public responses
comments.browser_storage: automatic per-comment credentials; memory fallback; no copy/download/manual recovery UI
comments.lost_credential: no insecure automatic recovery; contact owner for review
comments.delete_replies: deleting parent must not delete others' replies; erase deleted content and preserve minimal tombstone when needed
comments.load: after visitor requests comments, no per-card comment counts or polling
comments.antispam: Turnstile server-side verify + hostname/action + persistent short-lived rate limits

thread_keys.mapped_podcast: same article:<mapped_work_id> resolved by approved GUID mapping
thread_keys.manifest: generated from published catalog/publications; reject unknown IDs server-side; preserve aliases for deliberate later mappings

comments.admin_navigation: private bookmark -> Cloudflare Access -> central management; one-way return to public comment
comments.admin_url_delivery: private local configuration only; no public build or PR/README

contact.recipient: author-specified Gmail from conversation; set and verify privately in provider dashboard
contact.spam_protection: Formspree supported built-in/reCAPTCHA free capabilities; do not assume Turnstile is validated by Formspree
contact.public_email_decision: confirm during the single setup session; recipient authorization is not automatic public disclosure
contact.no_config_behavior: honest unavailable state or author-approved email-only contact; never pretend a form was sent
contact.success_wording: provider accepted submission; actual arrival separately verified by author
contact.failure_behavior: preserve unsent content, no unbounded automatic retries, show explicit fallback

required_configuration.name: Cloudflare account + Workers Free + Zero Trust Free
required_configuration.source: author-owned account and explicit local login

required_configuration.name: D1 staging and production database IDs
required_configuration.visibility: deployment config; not secret but do not invent
required_configuration.needed_for: live staging/production; local D1 works first

required_configuration.name: public API and admin worker URLs
required_configuration.needed_for: frontend cloud integration; do not apply /fansi-notes to Worker routes

required_configuration.name: ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN, ACCESS_AUD, ADMIN_EMAIL_ALLOWLIST
required_configuration.visibility: server-only config; author identity kept private

required_configuration.name: ALLOWED_ORIGINS / hostname allowlists
required_configuration.source: existing site configuration and explicit staging origins
required_configuration.needed_for: CORS and Turnstile validation; no wildcard credentials

required_configuration.name: FORMSPREE_ENDPOINT and verified recipient
required_configuration.source: author-owned Free form; owner verifies the already specified Gmail
required_configuration.visibility: endpoint public; recipient only provider settings
required_configuration.needed_for: real contact submission and mail delivery

required_configuration.name: GOATCOUNTER_ENDPOINT
required_configuration.visibility: public ingestion endpoint, private account token never client-side

required_configuration.name: PUBLIC_CONTACT_EMAIL / explicit permission
required_configuration.source: one-time publication decision for backup email
required_configuration.needed_for: email-only fallback; not needed to implement form

known_missing_before_development: No real database IDs or Worker URLs provisioned
Turnstile and Access settings not supplied
Formspree endpoint and Gmail verification not completed
Email-publication and remote-test-deployment consent not yet recorded
completion_boundary: Spec and workflow are complete enough to implement locally; accounts, cloud resources, live delivery and deployed services are NOT already completed. Missing external settings must never stop local code work or be hidden in final acceptance.
